post.caption:
Energy per kilogram decides almost everything. Wood carries a little, coal about twice that, oil roughly twice coal again and it pours. A modern battery carries around a fiftieth of what the same weight of jet fuel does, which is fine for a car because a car sets its weight on a road. A plane has to lift its fuel for the whole flight and a ship has nowhere to stop. That is why cars electrified first and aviation and shipping are the hard cases.
